about_the_game:
Abyss Diver is a cooperative horror survival game for 1-4 players where you manage oxygen to survive in the deep sea.

In the dark and unfamiliar depths, oxygen is life and a precious resource. Players must share their limited oxygen and cooperate, or sometimes act selfishly to survive.

Key Features

  • Cooperative Survival: 1-4 players form a team to explore the deep sea, sharing oxygen to survive.

  • Resource Management Strategy: Efficiently utilize oxygen packs and equipment to extend your limited time.

  • Dangerous Environment and Creatures: Water pressure, visibility, and hostile creatures constantly threaten you.

  • Teamwork Tension: One person's decision can determine the survival of the entire team.

In the darkness of the deep sea, how many minutes can you endure?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mild horror and tension elements set in a deep-sea environment. 
Players may experience fear or discomfort due to darkness, limited visibility, and encounters with underwater creatures. 
There is no sexual or extreme violent content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Performance may vary depending on graphics settings and hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Explore the abandoned city deep beneath the ocean. Gather resources before your oxygen runs out, and cooperate with your teammates amidst the threat of monstrous creatures. A cooperative underwater survival action game where a single decision can mean life or death.
